title: Emergency Powers
description: Understanding constitutional provisions for emergency situations and their implementation in Nepal.

sections.title: Concept and Rationale
sections.content: Emergency powers enable swift state response to crises threatening national security, public order, or catastrophe mitigation. They are exceptional and time-bound to prevent abuse.

sections.title: Declaration Process
sections.content: Formal declaration requires defined triggers, executive initiation, and legislative oversight. Documentation specifies scope, duration, and affected rights.

sections.title: Rights Derogation and Limits
sections.content: Some rights may be limited under emergency conditions; others remain non-derogable. Proportionality and necessity principles guide any restriction applied.

sections.title: Accountability and Oversight
sections.content: Periodic reporting, judicial review, and legislative renewal requirements ensure emergency measures do not become normalized or abusive.

sections.title: Historical Context and Lessons
sections.content: Past emergency applications highlight risks of scope creep and delayed termination, informing stronger temporal limits and transparency norms.

sections.title: Operational Coordination
sections.content: Inter-agency command structures, resource mapping dashboards, and decentralized reporting channels enhance situational awareness and targeted response.

sections.title: Oversight Enhancement Mechanisms
sections.content: Independent review panels, publication of derogation justifications, and real‑time civil society feedback portals bolster legitimacy and proportionality assessment.

sections.title: Case Study: Public Health Emergency
sections.content: A health emergency response used targeted movement restrictions with sunset clauses and frequent data releases, preserving essential rights while containing spread.

sections.title: Future Outlook
sections.content: Advances will emphasize granular risk zoning, interoperable crisis data, AI‑assisted early warning, and codified proportionality audit trails.

summary: Emergency powers are exceptional, time‑bound governance tools
Declarations hinge on defined triggers + legislative oversight
Historical use underscores need for strict temporal limits
Enhanced oversight: review panels & justification transparency
Case evidence: targeted, data‑transparent health measures work
Future: granular risk zoning & interoperable early warning data
